summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL), the Control.title classmethod with an Args docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (is_terminal check, buffers Control.title, returns True/False, no Windows or legacy checks, Google-style docstring noting Rich cannot restore the previous title); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(control_code[1]); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (forced terminal, skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only, mocked wrapper). Nothing was executed, so the tests are unverified. Choices: the CHANGELOG bullet names Console.set_window_title and links the PR URL; the Console test uses sys.platform for the skip rather than the legacy_windows flag.
